description: Look up the National Bank of Ukraine's official exchange rate (UAH per unit) for a currency, as of a given date or today if none is given. Supports historical dates for ЦК §533 п.2-style currency-conversion calculations, not only the current rate. Returns `available: false` with a null rate, rather than an error, when NBU has nothing published for the requested currency or date.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (Kyiv) when omitted.

name: ua_nbu_rate__rate
title: Get NBU Exchange Rate
